description: The agent reading secret files asks first: .env files, private keys, cloud and registry credentials (Read, Grep, NotebookRead and shell commands that print them). A guard rail through the agent's hooks; --hide keeps such files out of the workspace mount altogether (Knostic, 'From .env to Leakage', 2025-12).
